review_basis: registered O4-LAW-3 Rule-level transport and transfer provisions
semantic distinctness, legal-practice value and no-filler policy

decisions.rationale: The Rule-level permitted-material detail materially extends canonical OTSU4-Q-000162, which only tests a Decree-level steel example.
Robustness and leak-resistance are substantive container-structure requirements rather than a restatement of the Decree delegation rule.
The item asks which appendix the liquid-container provision points to rather than testing the transport standard itself; document-navigation recall is insufficient incremental Otsu4 practice value.
The item is the solid-container counterpart to C003 and likewise tests an appendix number instead of the substantive standard; retaining both would be quota-driven source navigation.
Sealing against temperature-driven leakage is a substantive storage-in-container rule not present in canonical transport questions.
The restricted gas-vent exception tests a useful conditional boundary distinct from the default sealing rule.
Chemical compatibility between the hazardous material and container material is an independent safety proposition.
The 95 percent solid fill ceiling is a source-explicit numeric boundary with practical transport value.
The 98 percent liquid fill ceiling is distinct from the solid limit and is independently testable.
The 55 degree C ullage requirement adds a thermal-expansion condition beyond the liquid fill-ratio recall in C009.
The one-outer-container restriction is a container-level rule and is materially distinct from canonical OTSU4-Q-000170's vehicle mixed-loading principle.
Specific identity and hazard marking fields add substantive Rule-level detail beyond canonical OTSU4-Q-000166's generic name/quantity marking duty.
The additional water-soluble marking for applicable Class-4 materials is Otsu4-specific and independently useful.
Mapping Class 4 to the required fire-prohibited caution marking is a direct qualification-relevant legal proposition.
The high-pressure-gas co-loading restriction supplies a concrete prohibited category beyond the generic mixed-loading rule.
The exact three-metre stacking ceiling materially extends canonical OTSU4-Q-000171, which only establishes that a ministerial ceiling exists.
Placard size, color, character and front/rear placement add substantive implementation detail beyond the existing threshold-duty question.
The over-four-hour continuous-driving criterion is a distinct numeric boundary for long transfer staffing.
The over-nine-hours-per-day criterion is a separate daily-duration boundary and not a wording variant of C018.

collision_review.note: C003 and C004 are rejected as low-value appendix-number navigation recalls. The remaining 17 Rule-level propositions materially extend the 18 verified Wave 3 transport questions without reproducing their answer-defining propositions.

source_review_scope: This gate checks registered-source relevance, locator reproducibility and answer-binding completeness; final canonical source verification remains separate after Permanent ID integration.
